title: pandas-dev/pandas CodeQL autobuild cannot build the C extension

ground_truth.fix_summary: Replace the codeql-action/autobuild step for the c-cpp language with explicit build steps that install the project build requirements, or switch that language to build-mode none.

provenance.notes: Labelled pipeline_config because the fix belongs in the workflow, not in the repository source: the action itself says 'We were unable to automatically build your code. Please replace the call to the autobuild action with your custom build steps.' The proximate error is '../meson.build:7:13: ERROR: Command `/usr/bin/python3 generate_version.py --print` failed with status 1.', which is the autobuild guess of a build command running under the system interpreter without the project build requirements. related_to_diff is false: the event is a scheduled run on main and the captured diff only rewrites LaTeX escapes in a docstring in pandas/core/generic.py, which cannot affect a meson configure step. culprit_files uses the workflow path the log itself reports as CODEQL_ACTION_ANALYSIS_KEY. Caveat on the taxonomy: none of the pipeline_config subcategories describes a misconfigured build step, and action_version was chosen as the nearest fit.
